shortDescription: Manage global PTP configurations on SONiC

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the configuration after module completion. C(merged) - Merges provided PTP configuration with on-device configuration. C(replaced) - Replaces on-device PTP configuration with provided configuration. C(overridden) - Overrides all on-device PTP configurations with the provided configuration. C(deleted) - Deletes on-device PTP configuration.
